spellbook.finance/limitations: Only the workspace owner may write an exact-price lock through delegated MCP.
The all_marketplaces scope is fixed by the existing SKU lock contract. This tool does not restore a price or trigger repricing.

description: Set one seller SKU's exact price lock and return its saved readback. Identify the exact printing, finish and condition. The lock scope is all marketplaces and no marketplace publish or repricing is triggered by this tool.

condition.description: The exact physical condition for the SKU. Required.

finish.description: The exact finish for the SKU: nf, fo, etched, surge, rh, 1e or 1e-fo. Required.

priceUsd.description: The seller-selected exact locked price in USD. Required.

scryfallId.description: The exact Scryfall printing id. Required.

workspaceId.description: The workspace the seller selected. The caller must own it. Required.

name: spellbook_sku_exact_price_lock_set
